name: Close-Grip Push-Up with Pause (Chain Weighted)
description: A close-grip push-up performed with chains draped over the back for added resistance, combined with a pause at the bottom for increased time under tension. The pause eliminates elastic energy storage and demands pure tricep and chest strength to initiate the push.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Close-Grip Push-Up with Pause (Chain Weighted) in the appropriate position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare equipment and body position for Close-Grip Push-Up with Pause (Chain Weighted).
steps: Step 1: Drape chains over upper back. Set up close-grip push-up position.
Step 2: Lower body to floor maintaining close hand position.
Step 3: Hold chest position for 2-3 seconds at bottom.
Step 4: Press explosively back to top position.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale during the exertion phase, inhale during the return.
safety_considerations: Keep joints aligned throughout the movement.
Use controlled weight appropriate for skill level.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Move through full range of motion without compromising joint integrity.
coaching_cues: Chains should stay across shoulder blades
